scope: Exact formerly failing 64-token prefix plus three owned short answers and native greedy EOS. No 16K runtime result is included.

model.execution: AMD official RyzenAI NPU configuration, including its CPU graph components; no GPU provider configured

package_identity.initial_scope: All manifest sizes; config/header content hashes. Backend computes runtime artifact hashes after model load.
package_identity.manifest_artifact_hash_source: Pinned package manifest; actual stream-verified by structural audit cd4cfc945fd9afffb3bead536b25dce217def8e11f3704e89d6f87ec40bc4b27.

input.interpretation: Exact first 64 tokens of the saved 16384-token head diagnostic. This is an incomplete prompt; no answer correctness criterion.

state_contract.qualification: Pinned static FP16 output shapes bound requested copies; Job memory limit also applies. Runtime returned shape/dtype are checked before statistics.

states.qualification: Final state observations are not the first failed layer/chunk. get_output copies existing outputs; no model forward is requested.

changes: Remove private absolute paths, PIDs/context IDs and filesystem stats.
Store repeated identical model/runtime hash metadata once and reference it from short rows.
Move exact existing state-statistics rows to a byte-identical JSONL artifact.
Compress original prefix logits losslessly with deterministic gzip mtime0.
Reconstruct owned prompt text/token IDs on CPU and verify their inference-recorded hashes.

limitations: The full 16K head/tail and near-boundary decode validation remain pending for this package.
NPU execution includes CPU control, slicing, assembly and other original CPU graph components; this is not an NPU-only arithmetic claim.
Prefix64 is an incomplete prompt, so its answer correctness is not evaluated.
Token Fusion DD token branch is unchanged; Loop prefill carries BF16 state after each token and is not claimed bit-equivalent to prior batched prefill.
Per-file runtime hashes are those recorded after model load; unmanifested runtime files are not reopened during this publication preparation.
